claim: A www → apex redirect for a Cloudflare Pages site is done with Bulk Redirects (plus a proxied www DNS record), not by attaching www as a Pages custom domain or with _redirects
where: PLANS/WORK-PACKAGES.md:143 and PLANS/SITE-STATE-CONTRACT.md:49 (attach anas.studio and www to the Pages project)
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/how-to/www-redirect/ (fetched 2026-10-07): to redirect www to the apex, create a bulk redirect list and rule on the Bulk Redirects page, then a proxied DNS record for www; https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/custom-domains/ 'Redirect between www and root domain': custom domains need an exact hostname match, so a redirect rule is required. The plan's step serves www without a redirect.
